title: A Study of SCAD Using Stress Contrast Echocardiography
official: Myocardial Perfusion in Spontaneous Coronary Artery Dissection Using Stress Contrast Echocardiography
summary: This study aims to fill knowledge gaps regarding microvascular perfusion and pressor response to stress among patients with history of spontaneous coronary artery dissection (SCAD) using stress contrast echocardiography.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adult \>18 years old
* Patient has a history of spontaneous coronary artery dissection (SCAD) OR patient is healthy with no significant medical history

Exclusion Criteria:

* Unable to give consent
* Allergic or have a history of adverse reaction to dobutamine, the Definity® ultrasound enhancing agent, or atropine.
* Has a known or suspected hypersensitivity to perflutren and therefore cannot be given Definity®.
* Pregnant.
* Unable to interrupt breastfeeding.
* Within 3 months of a heart attack.
* Severe aortic stenosis.
* Severe, uncontrolled hypertension (\>200/110 mmHg at baseline).
